bestBets.overview: EGERTON REEF deserves a breakthrough after two good runs in identical races. The form from last time is strong. It's similar form to ETCHED IN BLUE (Flying Capital) who was rock solid on pace here last time. GOTTACOOKACURRY's best run this prep was here. He was luckless and in the kickback for most of the way. He's a big price early. PRESTIGE ZERPRISE is ready to win. 1200m was too short for him on the synthetic and it was a dash home. Liked his work through the line. Then he went to a H9 at Echuca and he ran well again running out of room near the line. SINES DISCREETLY was ok here 2nd up behind ETCHED IN BLUE. He's at least a place chance at big odds. 5yo VIPERSTRIKE steps out to 1500m for the first time. There were excuses at Moe between two sound efforts. He's jumped out well on this track. LANCETTA has had 5 weeks to get over a strong return here in one of these races. The mare that won that race placed at Sandown in a BM64 after that.

raceTips.comment: Prestige Zerprise was a bit stiff not to win last start at Echuca. He looks set to peak third up and has found a very winnable race here. Lancetta found the line well first up and should be an improver now fitter. Viperstrike comes through a strong maiden last start at Murtoa and should improve on his home track. Egerton Reef will get a good run on speed.

bestBets.overview: SPIRITED DEFENCE, JUST FOR SHOW and SHAALUTE clashed in a race like this July 20 at Pakenham with SHAALUTE taking the honours. In a normal world it's difficult to comprehend how SPIRITED DEFENSE can be such a short priced fav ahead of SHAALUTE. The reason is of course, that SPIRITED DEFENSE returns to his home track synthetic where he's tasted defeat just once in 5 starts at 1200m. That was June 11 last year and incredibly it was SHALLUTE who beat him with 6.5kg less. John Allen goes back on S/DEFENCE and he's been the jockey for all four wins. SHAALUTE has a good record here too. CHARMING NIC has had a year off with feet issues. He's a synthetic winner in Queensland. MISS MAHJONG  races well here and now she gets some weight relief for the rise in grade.

raceTips.comment: Spirited Defence is a Ballarat Synthetic specialist. He won impressively two runs back here, I think he can bounce back to his best on his home track. Shaalute did beat home Spirited Defence last start and does have a scalp over him at this course but does carry 7.5kgs more today compared to that day. Miss Mahjong is another synthetic specialist, she attacked the line in good style last start.

bestBets.overview: STARBURST looks to be  a worthy short priced fav. She did everything bar win here last time. A brush with the rail late when off balance cost her victory. She's been 3wide on speed so it was a good run. Saw enough strength after the line to say 1100m will be fine. The lead looks hers. Back to Ballarat and the scene of her good return, should see BLISS BOMB be a strong danger. She was good 1st up in a better race than this. She's proven her self at 1100m when she won her maiden at Seymour. Hustle has placed at each of her 3 1st up runs. She's had experience here and been ok each time. FAST N INZAINE is yet to prove herself beyond 1000m but her return was encouraging.

raceTips.comment: Starburst was unlucky not to win last start, she got stuck three and four wide in the early stages then wanted to lay in for most of the straight then hit the rail in the concluding stages. Hopefully jockey and horse are better for the experience last start and can atone here. Bliss Bomb was good first up on this course, forgive last start at Sandown on a wet track. Fast 'N' Inzaine should be charging home late.

bestBets.overview: LOVE SPARKLES is in great form for her new stable. After her 1st up 1600m win she stayed at that trip and ran on indicating longer would suit now. AHAB is a track/trip specialist. After his win July 2 he was wide no cover the whole way when a solid 2nd to Dundonald. I'm sure AHAB thinks he won here last time. He was strong on the rail while the winner nabbed him on the line out very wide. He ran right through the line strongly.   ALL SO CLEAR won a race like this at Pakenham but his solid placing at Mildura. At Pakenham he had Dundonald behind him. KICKING KING has had a long spell due to a laceration he received back in October last year. He stays well and he certainly has the class to win a race like this if ready. PHAROAH'S DAUGHTER races beyond 1607m for the first time. To the eye unsure if it will suit or not. Breeding would suggest yes. KAWA won't be far away.

raceTips.comment: All So Clear brings in the strongest form coming through a Bm70 last start at Mildura. He should get a nice run from the draw here and be hard to beat. Love Sparkles looks ready to win now third up rising in distance. Ahab is flying, Anne-Jeanette Tindale has her small in great form of late.

bestBets.overview: Competitive race to finish with a lot of in form Ballarat synthetic horses clashing. Love the way WATT ON EARTH won here June 30. VALIDATED gets a soft trail with John Allen. He's so close to another win. NEWCOMBE like most of the Tindale stable horses is in great form. His times stacked up ok with SAVVIE BLANC when both were winners July 12. Cases can be made for LIFE SENTENCE, QUELLO DORATO, PHAROAH'S GLORY and SWYCHO.

raceTips.comment: Quello Dorato seems to have a real liking for this course. He won in good style last start and looks well placed here. Watt On Earth won well two back beating Life Sentence then was just outclassed at Flemington but still ran ok there. Life Sentence and Savvie Blanc both race very well at this track and can win. Deep race, tricky finish.
